research_interests.title: Research Interests
research_interests.description: My ultimate goal is to study and develop mathematical tools in combinatorics, algebra, probability and statistic to invent original coding techniques and new algorithms to solve real world problems. In particular, my research currently concentrates on coding theory including error correcting codes, constrained codes and rewriting codes with applications in several data storage systems. I am also interested in applying our techniques to protect the privacy of DNA data, to investigate the constrained languages, and to improve the accuracy of the computing, especially quantum computing and distributed computing.

bullet_points.description: Coding scheme to mitigate inter-cell interference and charge leakage concurrently in MLC flash memories.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, C. Johan, H. M. Kiah, S. Ling, T. T. Nguyen, V. K. Vu, 'Capacity-Achieving Constant-Composition Codes that Mitigates Intercell Interference in Flash Memories', Singapore provisional patent application, Ref No: TD/002/16.

bullet_points.description: Correcting errors in rank modulated flash memories.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, S. Ling, T. T. Nguyen, V. K. Vu, X. Zhang and H. Wei, 'Burst-Deletion-Correcting Codes for Permutations and Multipermutations', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 66, no. 2, pp. 957–969, 2020.

bullet_points.description: Coding scheme to expand the life-time of ReRAM.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, M. Horovitz, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, E. Yaakobi, 'Endurance-Limited Memories: Capacity and Codes', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 68, no. 3, pp. 1599–1613, 2022.

bullet_points.description: Two-dimensional codes for reducing parasitic currents in the crossbar resistive memories.
bullet_points.selected_paper: D. C. Nguyen, V. K. Vu, and K. Cai, 'Two-dimensional weight-constrained codes for crossbar resistive memory arrays', IEEE Communications Letter, vol. 25, no. 5, pp. 1435–1438, 2021.

bullet_points.description: Novel coding scheme for racetrack memories.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, H. M. Kiah, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, and E. Yaakobi, 'Coding for Racetrack Memories', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 64, no. 11, pp. 7094–7112, 2018.

bullet_points.description: Correct shift-errors in racetrack memories with multiple heads.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, T. Etzion, H. M. Kiah, S. Marcovich, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, E. Yaakobi, 'Locally-Constrained de Bruijn Codes: Properties, Enumeration, Code Constructions, and Applications', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 67, no. 12, pp. 7857–7875, 2021.

bullet_points.description: Novel constrained codes for transverse-read technology in racetrack memories.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, and E. Yaakobi, 'Transverse-Read-Codes for Domain Wall Memories', IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Information Theory, vol. 4, pp. 784–793, 2023.

bullet_points.description: Correcting synchronization errors in DNA nanopore sequencing.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, K. A. S. Immink, and V. K. Vu, 'Coding Scheme for Noisy Nanopore Sequencing with Backtracking and Skipping Errors', IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2024.

bullet_points.description: Protect the privacy of data in DNA synthesis.
bullet_points.selected_paper: S. Ling, K. H. Tang, V. K. Vu, H. Wang, and Y. Yan, 'Succinct Non-subsequence Arguments', presented in the International Conference on Security and Cryptography for Networks 2024.

bullet_points.description: Compute quantum channel fidelity.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, H. Ta, and V. K. Vu, 'An efficient parameterized algorithm for computing quantum channel fidelity via symmetries exploitation', accepted to IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory.

bullet_points.description: Correct synchronization errors in quantum communication channel using constrained de Bruijn sequences.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, D. T. Dao, T. L. Nguyen, D. H. Ta, and V. K. Vu, 'Run Length Limited de Bruijn Sequences for Quantum Communications', IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2022.

bullet_points.description: Propose a coding scheme to control the temperature of devices.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, T. Etzion, K. A. S. Immink, T. T. Nguyen, V. K. Vu, J. H. Weber, E. Yaakobi, 'Thermal-Aware Communications', accepted to IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, 2025.

bullet_points.description: Propose and study the first permutation codes in Generalized Kendall-tau and Cayley metrics.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee and V. K. Vu, 'Breakpoint Analysis and Permutation codes in Generalized Kendall tau and Cayley Metrics', in Proc. IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2014, pp. 2959–2963.

bullet_points.description: Best known permutation codes in Ulam metric.
bullet_points.selected_paper: S. Wang, V. T. Nguyen, Y. M. Chee, and V. K. Vu, 'Permutation and Multi-permutation Codes Correcting Multiple Deletions', accepted to IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory.

bullet_points.description: Propose to study the first codes correcting synchronization errors in symbol-pair read channels.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee and V. K. Vu, 'Codes Correcting Synchronization Errors for Symbol-Pair Read Channels', presented in the IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2020.

bullet_points.description: Best known two-dimensional codes correcting criss-cross errors.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, M. Hagiwara, and V. K. Vu, 'Two Dimensional Deletion Correcting Codes and their Applications', presented in IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2021.

bullet_points.description: Best known permutation codes and multi-permutation codes correcting deletions.
bullet_points.selected_paper: S. Wang, V. T. Nguyen, Y. M. Chee, and V. K. Vu, 'Permutation and Multi-permutation Codes Correcting Multiple Deletions', submitted to IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory.

bullet_points.description: Best known codes correcting a combination of adjacent transpositions and deletions.
bullet_points.selected_paper: S. Wang, V. K. Vu, and V. Y. F. Tan, 'Binary Codes for Correcting Asymmetric Adjacent Transpositions and Deletions', IEEE Transaction on Communications.

bullet_points.description: The first non-binary deletion-correcting codes that achieve the Singleton bound with small alphabet size.
bullet_points.selected_paper: M. Schaller, B. Toesca, and V. K. Vu, 'A New Construction of Non-Binary Deletion Correcting Codes and their Decoding', submitted to ISIT 2025.

bullet_points.description: ICI-free codes.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, C. Johan, H. M. Kiah, S. Ling, T. T. Nguyen, and V. K. Vu, 'Capacity-Achieving Codes that Mitigate Intercell Interference and Charge Leakage in Flash Memories', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 65, no. 6, pp. 3702–3712, 2019.

bullet_points.description: Locally constrained de Bruijn codes.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, T. Etzion, H. M. Kiah, S. Marcovich, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, E. Yaakobi, 'Locally-Constrained de Bruijn Codes: Properties, Enumeration, Code Constructions, and Applications', IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, vol. 67, no. 12, pp. 7857–7875, 2021.

bullet_points.description: Propose to study a new family of rewriting codes, called write ℓ-step-up memory codes.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, H. M. Kiah, A. J. H. Vinck, V. K. Vu, and E. Yaakobi, 'Coding for Write-ℓ-step-up Memories', presented in the IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2019.

bullet_points.description: Propose to study a new family of rewriting codes, called Endurance Limited Memories codes.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, M. Horovitz, A. Vardy, V. K. Vu, and E. Yaakobi, 'Codes for Endurance-Limited Memories', in Proceedings of the Int. Symp. Information Theory and Its Application 2018.

bullet_points.description: Study the model with blocks of defected items.
bullet_points.selected_paper: V. T. Bui, Y. M. Chee, J. Scarlet, and V. K. Vu, 'Group Testing With Blocks of Positives', in Proceedings of the IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2022.

bullet_points.description: Best known results on de Bruijn covering sequences.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, T. Etzion, H. Ta, and V. K. Vu, 'On de Bruijn Covering Sequences and Arrays', in Proceedings of the IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2024.

bullet_points.description: Design the optimal constrained de Bruijn sequences.
bullet_points.selected_paper: Y. M. Chee, T. L. Nguyen, V. D. Tran, V. K. Vu, 'Maximal Length Constrained de Bruijn Sequences', in Proceedings of the IEEE Int. Symp. Information Theory 2023.
